name: The Falconers: Moonlight
original_name: เดอะฟอลคอนเนอร์: มูนไลท์
source:
Eighty people, either dead or missing. Rumours of monsters that stalk their human prey in the mist-clad forest. Moonlight is a gold mining town in trouble, and only the Falconers can help.

The Falconers: Moonlight is a supernatural thriller visual novel set in the 19th Century West Coast of New Zealand. Falconer Cassandra Winter is on her first solo mission. Can she save the people of Moonlight from their plight? Or will she disappear into the mist like so many others before her?

[From the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170822104910/https://www.bionicpenguinstudios.com/moonlight/]official website[/url]]
translation:
八十人死亡或失踪。传闻有怪物在雾气笼罩的森林中追猎人类。淘金小镇Moonlight陷入困境，唯有“猎鹰人”能够伸出援手。

《The Falconers: Moonlight》是一部超自然惊悚视觉小说，故事发生在19世纪的新西兰西海岸。猎鹰人卡桑德拉·温特正在执行自己的首次单独任务。她能让Moonlight的居民摆脱困境吗？还是会像之前的许多人一样，消失在迷雾中？

（来源：[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170822104910/https://www.bionicpenguinstudios.com/moonlight/]官方网站[/url]）
